fusions.name: Skimmer's Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a spray of water into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, then skips to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 4 seconds. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Between the Plates
fusions.desc: A sliding kick on a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 30 water damage, rising to twice that at full reach, and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Out of the Net
fusions.desc: Slides you 2 tiles from where you stood, raises your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds and your dodge chance by 12% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Current Reader
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (16% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
